title: Man Opening a Hole in the Ice
place: frozen lake (location not given on page)
people: legs/boots only (dark trousers); a gloved hand briefly at the top edge at ~0.9, 9.3, 12.1 s; no face
notes: Top-down 4K (downscaled 1920x1080, 25->30 fps). Hand ice auger (teal blades, no visible brand/text) drilling into lake ice. 0-7 s: auger spins and is lifted in and out of the hole, white ice shavings ring around it. ~7.4 s: auger breaks through and lake water wells up, tinting the shavings yellow-green; 8.4-13 s water spreads across the ice surface around the hole (dark wet patch grows). Subject (hole) at x~0.62, y~0.5; boots on the left x~0.1-0.45. Shot A (setup) 1.0-3.6; shot B (result) 8.0-10.6.
